statement: TSMC CoWoS advanced packaging is the primary bottleneck, fully allocated through at least mid-2027 even as wafer capacity expands toward 120,000-130,000 wafers/month by end-2026.
why: Advanced-packaging allocation caps how fast GPU supply can grow despite wafer capacity additions.

impact.mechanism: CoWoS allocation ceiling constrains merchant-GPU output regardless of demand.

evidence.excerpt: primary bottleneck is TSMC CoWoS advanced packaging, fully allocated through at least mid-2027

confidence.basis: Single secondary report aggregating other supply pieces.
